fix: Block.java declares ~161 methods (162 including the constructor), not 148.
Item.java declares ~87 methods (88 including the constructor), not 64.
Entity.java declares ~185 methods (186 including the constructor), not 182.
width is the FULL hitbox width (0.6F default); setSize builds the AABB with width directly, not 2*width.
Only sneak/sprint-style flags use DataWatcher index 0; isSilent/setSilent use index 4.
EntityPlayer.java declares ~142 methods (145 including 3 constructors), not 140.
mc and sprintToggleTimer are protected, not private, in EntityPlayerSP.
World.java declares ~235 methods (236 including the constructor), not 232.
mcDataDir is `public final File mcDataDir`, not long.
leftClickCounter and rightClickDelayTimer are private ints; only skipRenderWorld is public.
No debugWireframe field exists in Minecraft.
Minecraft.java has ~99 public method declarations, so 115 is approximate at best.
getBlockReachDistance returns 5.0 creative, 4.5 survival (comment inverted and 6.0 wrong).
The riding C06(-999) sentinel lives in onUpdateWalkingPlayer's riding branch, unreachable via onUpdate (which bypasses it when riding).
Call sites use checkThreadAndEnqueue(packetIn, this, gameController): signature is (Packet, INetHandler, IThreadListener).
NetHandlerPlayServer sends S00 keep-alive when tick counter exceeds last ping by 40 ticks (~2s), not every 20s.
Three total C02 constructors exist: no-arg, (Entity, Action), (Entity, Vec3); the doc omits the no-arg one.
S46 is a PLAY-state packet; login-time compression uses S03PacketEnableCompression. S46 only updates the threshold.
EntityList has no getEntityStringFromClass; use getEntityString(Entity), getStringFromID(int), or getClassFromID(int).
1612 files is correct but net/minecraft/ has 25 top-level entries, not 23.
EnumChatFormatting has no getFormattingCode(); toString() returns section-sign+code; getters are getColorIndex()/getValueByName()/func_175744_a(int).
getBlockReachDistance()=4.5 survival/5.0 creative; server allows entity interact within 6.0 (distSq<36); no 3.0 value exists.
scheduledTasks is drained in runGameLoop before the tick loop, not inside runTick.
updateController only syncs held item (C09) and drains inbound packets; block damage/C07 STOP at >=1.0F lives in onPlayerDamageBlock, C0A in swingItem.
No myNetworkManager field; inbound packets drain via netClientHandler.getNetworkManager().processReceivedPackets().
No dedicated C02 ATTACK packet; attack is C02PacketUseEntity with Action.ATTACK enum value.
EntityItem, EntityXPOrb, EntityArrow directly extend Entity; EntityCreature extends EntityLiving extends EntityLivingBase.
EntityEnderPearl is in net.minecraft.entity.item, not .projectile.
No EntityAmbient class; it is EntityAmbientCreature, parent of EntityBat (Ghast extends EntityFlying).
EntityMob extends EntityCreature, but EntityAnimal extends EntityAgeable; Villager extends EntityAgeable, Wolf extends EntityTameable.
S14/S18 are received by NetHandlerPlayClient.handleEntityMovement/Teleport, which call setPositionAndRotation2 for interpolation.
Mob-side getHeldItem override is EntityLiving.getHeldItem() returning equipment[0], inherited by all mobs.
Base declares protected x,y,z,yaw,pitch,onGround,moving,rotating; only onGround is serialized at base level.
PlayerControllerMP.clickBlock sends only C07 START/ABORT; C0A comes from EntityPlayerSP.swingItem via Minecraft.clickMouse.
Creative path sends C07 START_DESTROY_BLOCK then calls clickBlockCreative, not onPlayerDestroyBlock.
onPlayerDamageBlock sends no C0A and progress goes to World.sendBlockBreakProgress, not to the server.
S25 is server->client; client renders progress via World.sendBlockBreakProgress.
C07 STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK is sent by onPlayerDamageBlock before calling onPlayerDestroyBlock, which sends no packet.
Client predictively removes via world.setBlockToAir in onPlayerDestroyBlock; S23 only later syncs/corrects.
getBlockReachDistance returns 4.5 survival, 5.0 creative; 6.0 is only the entity-search distance when extendedReach (creative).
getMouseOver delegates to Entity.rayTrace; entity sweep uses getEntitiesInAABBexcluding.
Slot has private final slotIndex, public slotNumber, xDisplayPosition/yDisplayPosition.
S46 is PLAY and only sent when compression changes, not as a routine join-burst packet.
Vanilla never sends C16 PERFORM_RESPAWN as a join-ready signal; it is a post-death respawn request.
PLAY registers 100 packets (74 CLIENTBOUND + 26 SERVERBOUND), not 94.
S01PacketJoinGame ctor includes hardcoreMode: (entityId, gameType, hardcoreMode, dimension, difficulty, maxPlayers, worldType, reducedDebugInfo).
directionMaps is private; use getPacket(direction, id) / getPacketId(direction, packet).
No NettyVarint21FrameDecoder in 1.8.9; framing is MessageDeserializer2, decoding is MessageDeserializer.
Decoder class is MessageDeserializer, not PacketDecoder.
Enqueued Runnable re-calls packet.processPacket(handler), which dispatches to handleXxx; not handleXxx directly.
Sneak logic calls getCollidingBoundingBoxes in three separate offset loops, not getCollisionBoxes once.
Field is private boundingBox, not bb; code uses getEntityBoundingBox().addCoord(x, y, z).
Source uses strict less-than: onGround = isCollidedVertically && d4 < 0.0D.
Max Depth Strider gives water friction f1=0.546, not 0.96.
Ground accel is getAIMoveSpeed() * (0.16277136/f4^3), i.e. landMovementFactor, not hardcoded 0.1.
+X is east and -X is west; the first ASCII diagram swaps them (the text list is correct).
-Z is north but sunset is west (-X); remove 'toward sunset' for -Z.
handleConfirmTransaction does no client-side revert on accept=false; it only replies C0FPacketConfirmTransaction(true). Resync comes via S2F/S30.
No PacketEncoder class in 1.8.9; outbound encoding is MessageSerializer + MessageSerializer2.
outboundPacketsQueue/flushOutboundQueue is only the pre-channel-open buffer; open-channel sends use writeAndFlush on the event loop.
